628:t_1:172.en:
$$セシル$$
「Even the numbers already confirmed make up an overwhelming swarm, I'm told.」

628:t_1:173.en:
$$ラクシャータ$$
「This is bad... If they'd only waited another month, we might have been able to do something...」

628:t_1:174.en:
$$ロイド$$
「We escape one crisis, only to face another...」

628:t_1:175.en:
$$ロイド$$
「Humanity might be finished before that system is complete...」

628:t_2:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「...Who are you!? What did you come here for!? Answer me!」

628:t_2:4.en:
$$刹那$$
「Please answer me! Your objective is...」

628:t_3:3.en: ～$$フロンティア船団$$ - Chief Aide's Office～

628:t_3:4.en:
$$三島$$
「...So the $$バジュラ$$ live in symbiosis with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$.」

628:t_3:5.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「It's nothing to be surprised about. Their biology is similar.」

628:t_3:6.en:
$$三島$$
「Then couldn't we control the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ too?」

628:t_3:8.en:
$$三島$$
「If we gain their power in addition to the $$バジュラ$$'s, our plan to conquer the galaxy will become much more realistic.」

628:t_3:9.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
(A man who did nothing but curry favor with the Empire is getting ideas above his station...)

628:t_3:10.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「I understand what you want. But there's still a lot we don't know about the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$.」

628:t_3:11.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「Depending on how things develop, we should also consider leaving the Earth Sphere.」

628:t_3:12.en:
$$三島$$
「True. It also concerns me that $$バジュラ$$ swarms have begun appearing frequently in the Earth Sphere.」

628:t_3:13.en:
$$三島$$
「Perhaps they dislike us controlling their swarms?」

628:t_3:14.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「But that's convenient for us. We'll fire implant rounds into them and add them to our forces.」

628:t_3:15.en:
$$三島$$
「Heh... The troublesome $$新地球皇国$$ will soon withdraw from Earth completely. Everything is going our way.」

628:t_3:16.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「I have more good news. By bringing the $$バジュラ$$ under our control, we also discovered the location of their homeworld.」

628:t_3:17.en:
$$三島$$
「We already know the $$バジュラ$$ Queen prefers Earthlike planets. That means...」

628:t_3:18.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「That will be our new frontier... Let's make it the home of the galaxy's rulers.」

628:t_3:19.en:
$$三島$$
「Emperor $$アウストラリス$$ withdrew, but I can't imagine $$サイデリアル$$ giving up on Earth.」

628:t_3:20.en:
$$三島$$
「Then let's abandon this backwater planet at once and carve out our own frontier.」

628:t_3:21.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$' arrival might give us the opportunity.」

628:t_3:22.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
(But what I don't understand is why the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ came to this backwater from the center of the galaxy...)

628:t_3:23.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
(Did some force bring them here...?)

628:t_3:27.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$ - Hangar～

628:t_3:29.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「They took him to the $$プトレマイオス$$' medical room.」

628:t_3:30.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「But they say he's still unconscious...」

628:t_3:31.en:
$$カイエン$$
「If I'd known this would happen, I'd have stopped that reckless attempt at dialogue...!」

628:t_3:32.en:
$$アマタ$$
「But I think $$刹那$$... would have gone even if we'd tried to stop him.」

628:t_3:33.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Mutual understanding through dialogue... That's what he's considered his mission since the $$再世戦争$$...」

628:t_3:34.en:
$$アルト$$
「But with him in this condition...」

628:t_3:36.en:
$$アンディ$$
「He... seemed like an unapproachable, cold bastard at first, but he was a passionate guy who cared about his friends...」

628:t_3:37.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Yes... To sacrifice his own body to save $$刹那$$...」

628:t_3:38.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「$$ティエリア$$ wasn't like that when we first met... He always put the mission first...」

628:t_3:39.en:
$$アルト$$
「But he changed. Through the $$破界事変$$ and the $$再世戦争$$, along with everyone in $$ソレスタルビーイング$$...」

628:t_3:42.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Damn it...! What the hell are those $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ things...!?」

628:t_3:44.en:
$$クレア$$
「Apparently that gravity quake was indeed the main $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ force teleporting in.」

628:t_3:45.en:
$$シリウス$$
「An enormous force is gathering there around the supergiant $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ that appeared.」

628:t_3:46.en:
$$アポロ$$
「And it's closing in on Earth...!」

628:t_3:47.en:
$$クレア$$
「The Federation forces are calling on $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s remaining forces for help, and apparently intend to wage an all-out battle.」

628:t_3:48.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Damn it...! We finally drove out the Empire, and now Earth's suddenly in danger again!?」

628:t_3:49.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「$$バアル$$... Humanity's natural enemy...」

628:t_3:50.en:
$$シリウス$$
「So their power far exceeds anything humanity could imagine...」

628:t_3:51.en:
$$アルト$$
(Our songs reached the $$バジュラ$$... But with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$... will they not work...?)

628:t_3:53.en:
$$ランカ$$
(If battles like this keep happening, $$アルト$$ and my brother could also...)

628:t_3:63.en:
???
「$$ティエリア・アーデ$$... You have lost your body.」

628:t_3:64.en:
???
「But since you're an $$イノベイド$$, your memories... Your mind, so to speak, is backed up in this $$ヴェーダ$$.」

628:t_3:65.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「$$リボンズ・アルマーク$$...! No... An $$イノベイド$$ of the same type as him!」

628:t_3:66.en:
???
「Welcome to $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$'s true plan. I will guide you... and humanity.」

628:t_3:67.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「$$イオリア$$'s... true plan...」

628:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...As I suspected, that gravity quake was probably separate from the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ hyperspace jump.」

628:t_10:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「...All right. We'll handle the rest of the investigation.」

628:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm counting on you. I have to run $$Ｄトレーダー$$ here.」

628:t_10:7.en:
$$トライア$$
「You still do business at a time like this? The sheer stubbornness of a dimensional merchant amazes me.」

628:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Gathering even a few more $$Ｚチップ$$s is my supreme priority, after all.」

628:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That said, I do believe we're in serious trouble this time, so my congratulations to our ace pilots will have to wait...」

628:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Will humanity on Earth really be able to overcome this trial...?」

629:t_001:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「The $$バスター軍団$$...! Their numbers have dropped so much!」

629:t_001:1.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Stand back! We'll take it from here!」

629:t_002:0.en:
$$チコ$$
「The $$バスター軍団$$... They're completely smitten with $$カズミ$$.」

629:t_002:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Just what I'd expect from $$ノリコ$$'s Big Sis.」
